test_title: PYST 63: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If two trains 200 m and 150 m long are running on parallel rails at the rate of 50 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively, find the relative speed if they are running in the same direction.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 200 m

Length of Train 2 = 150 m

Speed of Train 1 = 50 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 30 km/h

Direction: Same

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = |Speed₁ - Speed₂|

1 km/h = dfrac{5}{18} m/s

**Calculation:**

Speed of Train 1 = 50 × dfrac{5}{18} = dfrac{250}{18} m/s

Speed of Train 2 = 30 × dfrac{5}{18} = dfrac{150}{18} m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = dfrac{250}{18} - dfrac{150}{18}

⇒ Relative Speed = dfrac{100}{18} m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = dfrac{50}{9} m/s

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
